product: Web of Science Research Assistant + Extended Research Assistant
howItCompetes: Clarivate's flagship rival to LeapSpace, and the closest 1:1 match. Built on the Web of Science Core Collection — their answer to LeapSpace's ScienceDirect/Scopus foundation. New agentic guides (Topic Explorer, Find a Journal, and a multi-step literature review guide) turn any research question into a connected AI workflow, playing the same role as LeapSpace's Literature Search & Deep Research Reports. The Extended Research Assistant bridges into Web of Science Research Intelligence, carrying researchers from literature discovery through to funding opportunities and proposal strategy — directly mirroring LeapSpace's Funding Discovery tab.
sourceName: Clarivate — Web of Science AI Research Assistant

howItCompetes: Elicit's Pro-plan Research Agent autonomously searches, reads and extracts structured data across 125M+ papers (via Semantic Scholar) plus 545K+ clinical trials, then hands a populated, organized workspace off to a human researcher for review — the same territory as LeapSpace's Literature Search and Deep Research Reports. That extraction-and-synthesis loop is also a direct, if less branded, challenge to LeapSpace's Trust Cards & Claim Radar. It's sold direct to individual academics rather than bundled into an institutional subscription.

Purpose-built for the single job LeapSpace bundles as one tab among many: telling you whether the literature actually backs a claim. Smart Citations classify 1.2B+ citation statements as Supporting, Mentioning or Contrasting, letting a researcher audit a claim's evidence trail paper by paper — a narrower but deeper challenge specifically to LeapSpace's Trust Cards & Claim Radar.
sourceName: Best AI Research Assistants 2026 — Atlas Workspace

howItCompetes: A lightweight, consumer-friendly entry point that answers a research question directly from peer-reviewed literature with inline citations. Competes with LeapSpace's Literature Search & Discovery tab for quick evidence checks, though it doesn't attempt LeapSpace's full agentic workspace — reviewers rank it cleanest for fast, evidence-backed Q&A rather than deep review work.

product: SciSpace Research Workspace (AI Search, BioMed Agent, Meta-Analysis Agent, Manuscript Writer)
howItCompetes: The broadest multi-agent workspace challenger to LeapSpace. AI Search behaves like a research agent — querying 280M+ papers plus Google Scholar and PubMed, retrieving roughly 240 papers and extracting evidence from the top matches into a cited answer, matching LeapSpace's Literature Search and Deep Research Reports. Domain-specific agents (BioMed Agent, Meta-Analysis Agent) plus a Manuscript Writer agent go head-to-head with LeapSpace's Writing Coach, though independent reviews flag more hallucination risk in its in-paper explanations than source-grounded alternatives — exactly the gap LeapSpace's Trust Cards & Claim Radar is designed to close.
sourceName: Best AI Research Assistants 2026 — Atlas Workspace
